sources.title: Iwin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Interleaved Windows
sources.snippet: The combined design enables Iwin to achieve an equivalent global receptive field of two consecutive Swin blocks with approximately half the computational cost, making it particularly advantageous for high-resolution vision applications and more amenable to integration with text-conditioning mechanisms in generative models.
